title: Early supported discharge for older adults admitted to hospital after orthopaedic surgery: a systematic review and meta-analysis.

evidence.reason: Inventory must identify exactly k distinct trials

adjudication.design_quote: Randomised controlled trials or quasi-randomised controlled trials were the study designs included.
adjudication.k_quote: Seven studies with a population of older adults post orthopaedic surgery met inclusion criteria, with five studies included in the meta-analysis.
adjudication.reason: RCT/quasi-RCT-only review with pooled pairwise meta-analysis; seven included trials (five pooled) gives k=7.
